name: Registration of Aromatic Plant Farmers - Centre for Aromatic Plants
benefit: - Registration of farmers with the Aromatic Plant Centre (CAP) is mandatory to avail of the benefits of all the schemes run by the Aromatic Plant Centre. - After registration, CAP provides farmers with facilities such as subsidies provided by the State and Central Governments, technical information, training, product clearance, etc.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The farmer must either legally own agricultural land or have leased land for a minimum period of 10 years. 1. The farmer must be engaged in aromatic plant cultivation.
